## Coda — `apps/coda/` plan summary

A **self-contained static vanilla-TS PWA** (no new framework dep, no workspaces) at `apps/coda/`, reusing root deps (`marked`, `fuse.js`, `@playwright/test`, `@axe-core/playwright`). This is the only architecture that keeps the domain layer genuinely pure and root churn minimal.

**8 steps:** scaffold → pure-TS domain layer (types/repository/serializable store/Fuse search/markdown round-trip, dual-reviewed) → test-first domain units → UI + isolated IndexedDB adapter → PWA (manifest + hand-rolled SW + offline fallback) → isolated Playwright config with offline-persistence + axe specs → root wiring (one tsconfig include, one CI job, eslint, bunfig preload check) → DOX/docs via documenter.

**Key specialist rulings:**
- *product-strategist*: v1 = Chromium-desktop-only installable PWA (Safari/Android deferred, not claimed); one board, 3 fixed statuses; **markdown export/import is the "local-first" proof**; first-verified target is one green offline-persistence spec.
- *solution-architect*: static app beats nested Next; hand-rolled SW beats workbox; IndexedDB in a separate adapter module keeps the domain DOM-free.
- *qa-architect*: frozen-lockfile stays green by keeping Coda dep-free at root; isolate the Coda Playwright lane so the landing lane never goes down; `waitForFunction` on SW controller (no sleeps); assert installability via manifest fetch, not the flaky headless `beforeinstallprompt`.

**Verification:** `bun test apps/coda` · `bun run typecheck` · `bun run lint` · `bunx playwright test -c playwright.coda.config.ts` · `bunx playwright test` (landing stays green) · `bun run check:docs` · a grep proving zero DOM globals in the domain layer.

Plan mode is still active (read-only). Approve to execute; the run closes with `plan_retrospective`.
